title: observability-weekly-2026-07-20
content:
Observability team — weekly notes (week of 2026-07-20)

Attendees:
- Aisha (owner), Markus, Lina, Tom, Priya, Sam (SRE), Elena (platform)

TL;DR:
- Tracing: rolled new sampling config to 30% for low-traffic services; ingest down ~18% and tail latency visibility improved.
- Dashboards: merged cardinality-reduction PR; dashboard render time improved ~40% on low-memory grafana nodes. Need follow-up to rename panels and add helper text.
- Cost telemetry: prefix KV caching rollout to prod reduced inference-host token compute cost ~12% for main tenant. Working on per-route cost attribution (WIP).

Metrics snapshot (end of week):
- Traces ingested (p50): baseline -> 5.2M/day; after sampling -> 4.2M/day
- OTEL collector CPU: down 15% on collector pool
- Dashboard render latency (median): 320ms -> 190ms after PR merge
- Alert noise: error-rate-alert firing 6 -> 2 times/day after alert tuning
- Cost: observed 12% reduction in GPU token compute spend for the prefix cache cohort (week-over-week)

Key updates / notes:
1) Tracing
- Sampling rollout (Markus)
  - Status: progressive rollout to canary -> staging -> production. Canary looks good (no missing spans for customer flows).
  - Data: sampling config commit: github.com/redwood-inference/observability/commit/abcd123 (see PR #345).
  - Follow-up: add deterministic sampling for critical endpoints (OBS-4321). Owner: Markus. ETA: 2026-07-28.
- OTEL collector tuning (Tom)
  - Decreased batch_size and increased flush_interval for heavy service lanes — lowered CPU spikes during traffic bursts. Need to monitor tail end-to-end latencies for long traces.
  - Blocker: one service (recommendation-svc) still emits high-cardinality attributes (user_id, session_id) to tracing; need a migration plan. Action: Priya to draft attribute-sanitization RFC.

2) Dashboards and observability UI
- Cardinality-reduction PR merged (Lina) — removed 3 high-cardinality labels from mainRequest panel. Render times improved but several panels missing helper text.
- Dashboards deep-dive meeting notes (7/21) — decisions:
  - Rename "mainRequest" -> "request-overview" (backwards-compatible alias for 30 days). Owner: Lina.
  - Add per-route cost widget to top of infra dashboard (prototype in grafana folder). Owner: Aisha. ETA: 2026-07-27.
  - Move long-running queries to snapshot panels (reduces live query load). Owner: Elena.
- Dashboard alert tuning:
  - error-rate-alert threshold adjusted from 1.5% -> 2.0% for low-traffic routes; we saw a 60% reduction in noisey pager events. Need to document thresholds per tier.

3) Cost telemetry and attribution (big picture)
- Prefix / KV cache rollout: initial cohort shows ~12% GPU token compute reduction; memory and cache hit-rates consistent with expectations.
- Next: implement per-route cost accounting to charge teams and detect runaway tenants. Proposal posted in Confluence (linked). Action: Aisha + Finance sync next week to validate rate models.
- Metric to add: cost_per_1M_tokens_last_7d (derived) + per-customer breakdown. Owner: Priya. ETA: 2026-08-03.

Standup snippets (weekly):
- Aisha: finished dashboard PR for per-route cost widget; working on wiring cost metrics into infra dashboard; blocked on schema change in telemetry-bridge (OBS-4298).
- Markus: sampling rollouts look stable; investigating a small gap in traces for oauth flow (repro steps logged in OBS-4321).
- Lina: dashboard rename + helper text work in progress; will pair with UX to craft descriptions.
- Tom: OTEL collector tuning applied to collector-pool-2; need to watch GC cycles on small nodes.
- Priya: starting attribute-sanitization RFC; will include a migration window and changelog for downstream consumers.

Incidents / postmortems
- Brief alert spike on 2026-07-19 evening tied to bad client deploy that changed span attributes and increased cardinality -> DB slow queries -> dashboard timeouts. Root cause: client emitted full user metadata in span attributes. Mitigation: blocked deploy and rolled sampling config. Long-term: attribute sanitization RFC. Jira: OBS-4298.

Action Items (with owners / dates):
- OBS-4321: Add deterministic sampling for critical endpoints — Markus — due 2026-07-28.
- Rename mainRequest -> request-overview and add alias — Lina — due 2026-07-24.
- Per-route cost widget prototype -> merge to grafana repo — Aisha — due 2026-07-27.
- Attribute-sanitization RFC + migration plan — Priya — draft due 2026-07-23.
- Finalize cost model sync with Finance (meeting) — Aisha + Finance — meeting scheduled 2026-07-22.
- Snapshot panels for long queries (reduce live load) — Elena — due 2026-07-30.

Open questions / parking lot:
- How granular should per-route cost attribution be? Per-service vs per-endpoint vs per-tenant? (Cost/benefit; storage/query volume tradeoffs)
- Do we want to expose the sampling level per-tenant in Console? Privacy concerns to discuss.
- Need an automated test to ensure no new high-cardinality labels are added by PRs (pre-commit or CI check).

Notes to self / team reminders:
- Link dashboards in weekly update email (Aisha)
- Add alert docs to ops-runbook for error-rate tuning
- Keep canary sampling at stable level until deterministic sampling PR lands

Attachments / links referenced in this doc:
- Confluence design: https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=4829102
- Jira: OBS-4321 / OBS-4298 (see linked_artifacts above)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/345

If anything missing or if you want a deeper deep-dive on cost calc (per-route examples + sample SQL), ping me and I'll add an appendix.

-- Aisha
